description: This Java source file defines the class LegacyKeypadEvent, which is a specific type of ClusterCommandEvent used to represent keypad events in a Zigbee core mocking environment. The class constructs command payloads for such events, encapsulating details like button pressed, access code, battery voltage, and temperature readings.

classes.name: LegacyKeypadEvent
classes.description: Represents a keypad event command with payload preparation specific to keypad button presses in a Zigbee security context.

methods.name: LegacyKeypadEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the keypad event with identifiers, button pressed, access code, battery voltage, and temperature components.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Generates and returns the byte array payload for the keypad event command, structured with specified data fields.
